notes: Body queries contextual status IDs 0x24 and 0x26, returning true if either matches; otherwise it obtains selector-3 value and compares it to x1. Callers use the result as a boolean in attribute-related logic, supporting the proposed name.

The full wrapper checks x2; when nonzero it musttail-forwards unchanged to f_7000759210, and when null returns false. The callee performs the decoded-key record matching, while the caller passes an output slot in x2 and uses the boolean result to continue its match path. A guarded forwarding/matching label is supported; the blank can be named at this level.

Body verifies the context fields, queries status 0x13, requires returned low byte 4, stores the input byte at object +0x2c, and invokes its helper with selector 8. Caller is dispatch_context_status_attribute_event and passes a candidate attribute record; proposed name matches this behavior.

Body obtains a dispatcher from input1 +0x130, calls it with input0, low 32 bits of input2, and an output pointer, then on success forwards the result to populate_contextual_player_attribute_status_values. Caller supplies a player-attribute slot and status/index value, supporting the label.

Body gets a base value, dispatches attribute-delta application for the supplied index, and for indices 0 or 1 chooses offset 0x5db0 or 0x5e20 from a returned base before calling a helper. The gameplay attribute-update caller invokes it with index 3 and the current record. The proposed name captures the indexed delta and offset branches.
